fixes.text: The 1 m layer is missing. On side_l and side_r the black sills under the doors and the lower body are bare from wheel to wheel. The nose corners in front34 and crop-nose carry no marks, and the rear bumper in rear34 has only the 451 and the icon stack. I count about nine roster marks in all, where the brief asks for fifteen or more. Paul Miller (anchor 24) has rows of small partners on its sills and bumpers, and next to it this car reads unfinished up close.

The green door field behind 'zentiq ENERGY RACING' is one flat acid green on side_l and side_r. The darker-green tone blocks the brief promises show only in a thin rim under the window (crop-beltline) and on the roof (top), never in the door itself. It is the plainest area on the car, at the spot that gets looked at most.

In front34 and crop-nose, the black 451 block on the bonnet runs into the black bonnet vent, so the two read as one long black bar. The number block should either clearly sit apart from the vent or clearly belong to it.

lint_missed: front34 / crop-nose: the bonnet's black 451 block merges with the black bonnet vent into one shape. A flat texture can't show this.

side_l / side_r: the sim's light panel sits only about a letter's width from the 'q' (side_l) and the 'z' (side_r) of the door zentiq, so it reads as crowding the wordmark rather than sitting in its own block.
side_l: HUILEC is set in from the 451 block's left edge, and DREXA runs past the right edge of the ENERGY RACING line. The small lines under the lockup don't share its edges.

answers.note: Sim 20261021-201950 adds ten roster placements. side_l and side_r: a grey Telvio plate on top of the 451 block that shares the block's edges (the WeatherTech plate on the Paul Miller car), and a black block behind the front wheel holding the Grivant and Avelor marks stacked; front34 shows both. top and rear34: a black block with the Huilec mark across the green vent from the bonnet's 451, plus the Drexa and Grivant marks either side of the wing's zentiq. With the sill rows, mirrors, plate stack, deck and grille uprights, each side shot now shows 11 marks besides zentiq, and the top shows 5. The sill under the door (v < 0.2) faces down: no camera sees it square-on, so the rows stay on the black blocks at the door's foot.

side_l and side_r in sim 20261021-201950: the headline plate is now a mosaic of its own, about 55% darker green #78b000 in big and medium blocks under the black zentiq and ENERGY RACING, which read on both tones. The green zone's body also carries 1.8 times the blocks (green_tone), so the door around the plate is stepped in two greens like the grey nose and the black tail.

The bonnet vent is painted acid green (the brief's intake accent), and a second black block mirrors the 451 block across it, carrying the Huilec mark. In front34 and top of sim 20261021-201950 the 451 block ends at a green bar, and the two black blocks either side of the green vent read as a pair of their own.

taste.where: side_l and side_r, lower door: HUILEC doesn't line up with the 451 block above it (side_l: it starts well in from the block's left edge and runs past its right edge onto the green; side_r: it starts left of the block and stops short of its right edge). DREXA lines up with neither ENERGY RACING nor the block edges, so the bottom row floats under a lockup that is otherwise aligned.

fixes.text: The small type under the door lockup isn't aligned. On side_l, HUILEC starts well inside the left edge of the black 451 block and runs past its right edge onto the green. On side_r it starts left of the block and stops short of its right edge. DREXA lines up with neither ENERGY RACING nor any block edge on either side. The telvio plate, the 451 block and the zentiq / ENERGY RACING pair all share edges, so this bottom row is the one place where the side reads as a stack of labels. Each small line should share an edge with the block or line above it. This is the alignment complaint the owner made on eva-nerv.

The front and rear ends are still thin at 1 m. In front34 and crop-nose, the bumper corners and the grey lower nose carry no partner marks at all, only the tow hook and lights. In rear34 the rear face below the lights has only the sim's 451 and the icon stack at one corner, with the middle plain black. The sides now hold their share (telvio plate, the marks behind the front wheel, HUILEC, DREXA, the plate stack). Paul Miller (anchor 24) puts small partners on its nose corners and across its rear bumper, and next to it this car's two ends look unfinished up close.

On side_l and side_r, behind the door window, the black haunch top meets the green side along one long, clean, raked edge on the shoulder crease. It is the only plain diagonal cut between two colours on a car whose brief bans them, and everywhere else the fields interleave in blocks.

lint_missed: side_l / side_r: on the 3D body, the black haunch top and the green side meet at the shoulder crease behind the door window as one long clean diagonal edge. The flat texture shows stepped blocks there, but the fold turns them into a straight raked line.
front34 / crop-nose: the gold tow hook and the gold light bar sit on the grey nose with no partner marks around them, so the bumper face reads as hardware on mosaic rather than a carried partner row.
blocked: The sill face under the doors faces downward, and the builder reports that no camera sees it square-on, so a partner row there can't be judged. The marks sit on the black blocks at the foot of the door instead (side_l, side_r).
